mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_inventory_allocation (pool_id, demand_key, root_material_code, source_month, priority_seq, path_hash, gross_qty, allocated_qty, allocation_type, adjustment_reason, manual_confirmed, revision) VALUES (#{poolId}, #{demandKey}, #{rootMaterialCode}, #{sourceMonth}, #{prioritySeq}, #{pathHash}, #{grossQty}, #{allocatedQty}, #{allocationType}, #{adjustmentReason}, #{manualConfirmed}, #{revision})

INSERT INTO mrp_inventory_allocation (pool_id, demand_key, root_material_code, source_month, priority_seq, path_hash, gross_qty, allocated_qty, allocation_type, adjustment_reason, manual_confirmed, revision) VALUES
(#{item.poolId}, #{item.demandKey}, #{item.rootMaterialCode}, #{item.sourceMonth}, #{item.prioritySeq}, #{item.pathHash}, #{item.grossQty}, #{item.allocatedQty}, #{item.allocationType}, #{item.adjustmentReason}, #{item.manualConfirmed}, #{item.revision})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_inventory_allocation SET allocated_qty=#{allocatedQty}, allocation_type=#{allocationType}, adjustment_reason=#{adjustmentReason}, manual_confirmed=#{manualConfirmed}, revision=#{revision} WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} - 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_allocation WHERE pool_id=#{poolId} ORDER BY demand_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_inventory_allocation WHERE pool_id=#{poolId}
SELECT a.* FROM mrp_inventory_allocation a INNER JOIN mrp_inventory_pool p ON a.pool_id = p.id WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY a.demand_key
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM mrp_inventory_allocation a INNER JOIN mrp_inventory_pool p ON p.id = a.pool_id WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId} AND COALESCE(a.allocation_type, 'AUTO_PRIORITY')='AUTO_PRIORITY'

DELETE a FROM mrp_inventory_allocation a INNER JOIN mrp_inventory_pool p ON p.id=a.pool_id WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId} AND COALESCE(a.allocation_type, 'AUTO_PRIORITY')='AUTO_PRIORITY' AND (a.path_hash IS NOT NULL AND a.path_hash <> a.root_material_code OR a.path_hash IS NULL AND (p.material_code <> a.root_material_code OR a.demand_key <> CONCAT(a.root_material_code,'|',a.root_material_code,'|',DATE_FORMAT(a.source_month,'%Y-%m-%d'))))
